forbidden.name: no-module-to-module
forbidden.comment: Issue #173: a module may only be imported by another module through its public entry point (src/index.ts). Reach into another module's internals directly, and this rule fires.

forbidden.name: no-service-to-service
forbidden.comment: Issue #173: the deployable processes under services/ talk to each other only through Postgres, never by importing one another's code — not even through a public entry point, since importing a service's module bundles its runtime dependency stack into the caller and defeats independent deployability.

forbidden.name: no-service-to-module
forbidden.comment: Issue #173: a service never imports module code across the service boundary; it reaches persisted state the same way every other process does — through Postgres.

forbidden.name: no-module-to-service
forbidden.comment: Issue #173: a module never imports service code; a service is a separate deployable process, not a library a module can depend on.

forbidden.name: core-knows-nobody
forbidden.comment: Issue #173: packages/* are the neutral core the rest of the system depends on; they import no module or service code, so a core package can never end up coupled to one vertical slice or one process.

forbidden.name: pi-only-in-agent-runtime
forbidden.comment: Issue #173: pi-agent-core (the pinned @earendil-works/pi-agent-core package) is opaque outside the runtime that wraps it — only packages/agent-runtime may import it directly.

forbidden.name: agent-runtime-only-in-agents
forbidden.comment: Issue #173: packages/agent-runtime drives the agent loop; only services/semprec-agents (its composition root, issue #91) may import it. In particular, services/semprec-api never runs the agent loop itself.

forbidden.name: no-deep-imports
forbidden.comment: Issue #173: a package is imported only through its entry point (src/index.ts) or the hardcoded testSupport/ secondary entry path (matching what @semprec/data's package.json `exports` separately declares as its public testSupport surface — this rule does not read package.json itself). Reaching past that into another package's internals is forbidden even for a different package under packages/.

forbidden.name: no-deep-imports
forbidden.comment: Issue #173: same entry-point-only rule as above (index.ts or the hardcoded testSupport/ path), for modules/services reaching into a package's internals instead of its declared entry points.

forbidden.name: no-agent-runtime-internal-cross-import
forbidden.comment: SRP/ISP boundary (issue #137): agent-runtime's lifecycle/audit internals are reached only through its published port (src/index.ts) — never a caller reaching past it into lifecycleAdapter.ts, delegationRegistry.ts, sempConversation.ts, etc. directly.

forbidden.name: no-agent-runtime-provider-internals
forbidden.comment: DIP boundary (issue #137): agent-runtime depends only on the CreateAgentSession/AgentSession/CompactionAdapter/PiProviderRegistry ports it declares itself, never on the pinned pi-agent-core packages or a model provider's own package directly. src/__tests__/ is exempt: issue #134's piRuntimeContract.unit.test.ts is the one sanctioned direct import, pinning the exact shape those ports are written against.

forbidden.name: no-agent-runtime-guidance-database-import
forbidden.comment: Issue #214: the project-agent-guidance systemPromptOverride adapter receives an injected loadProjectAgentGuidance port and must never import pg, a pool singleton, or @semprec/data's concrete store directly.

forbidden.name: no-application-into-services-or-agent-runtime
forbidden.comment: Issue #214: packages/application/src/projectAgentGuidance is a neutral application service — it may depend on packages/shared's generic ports, never on services/* (its composition-root consumers) or packages/agent-runtime (a different consumer).

forbidden.name: no-application-gateway-implementation-import
forbidden.comment: Issue #215: packages/application imports only @semprec/shared's AiGatewayClientPort — never packages/ai-gateway-client's HTTP implementation nor packages/ai-gateway itself — so it stays ignorant of how a structured completion actually reaches a provider.

forbidden.name: no-model-provider-dependency-outside-gateway
forbidden.comment: Issue #215 acceptance criterion: no direct model-provider dependency exists outside semprec-ai-gateway. Only services/semprec-ai-gateway/src may import a model-provider SDK package directly.

forbidden.name: no-core-table-write-outside-choke-point
forbidden.comment: Issue #154 / docs/adr/2026-09-10-choke-point-api-for-state-writes.md: only packages/data (the choke-point package) may write the core tables items/databases/properties. A route handler, adapter, or module anywhere else must go through the choke-point's exported service calls (@semprec/data's createChokePoint and friends), never chokePoint/itemsStore.ts, chokePoint/databasesStore.ts, or chokePoint/propertiesStore.ts directly.

forbidden.name: items-store-private
forbidden.comment: Issue #173 / #243: the item store is the privileged SQL layer for the choke-point's most sensitive table — visible only inside packages/data. This is the static (CI) half of the choke-point write control; the runtime half is the semprec_data/semprec_side least-privilege Postgres roles delivered by #243.
